hints.title: Collinearity and Cross Product
hints.text: Three points form a boomerang if they are distinct and do not lie on a single straight line. Collinearity corresponds to zero signed triangle area.

hints.title: Avoid Division and Floating Point
hints.text: Comparing slopes (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) requires handling division by zero. Instead, cross multiply: (x2 - x1) * (y3 - y1) against (y2 - y1) * (x3 - x1).

hints.title: Non-Zero Area Criterion
hints.text: Calculate cross product (x2 - x1) * (y3 - y1) - (y2 - y1) * (x3 - x1). Return true if this quantity is non-zero, meaning points are distinct and non-collinear.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Slope division can cause divide-by-zero exceptions on vertical lines.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: The 2D cross product requires only integer multiplication and subtraction in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid division by zero using the 2D cross product / determinant.
complexity.notes: Equal points naturally produce a cross product of zero.
